openings.claim: A manifest-ordered digest ledger can report the earliest evidenced mismatching boundary, or an unresolved interval where earlier supplied evidence is incomplete, while separating mismatch observations from possible explanations.
openings.delta: Change the ordering dependency from local timestamps to the supplied manifest stage order. Carry comparisons in a spreadsheet or local script ledger containing paired record identifiers, input/output digest agreement, missing fields, inspection counts and uncertainty. The nearest rival is timestamp-sorted comparison, which can place the anomalous export record before parse.
openings.prediction: The ledger and timestamp rival will differ in ordering the anomalous export record. Missing transform output digests will prevent a definite earliest-boundary claim unless other supplied records resolve that gap. A shared ingest output establishes equality only at that recorded boundary. The ledger is defeated if it gives a definite earliest stage across an unresolved earlier gap, treats removal as nonexecution, or exceeds twelve manual inspections per pair.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes, process all six pairs, count each manual record inspection, and cap each pair at twelve. Compare available digests in manifest order; cite every definite stage claim. If evidence is incomplete, report the interval from the last evidenced equal boundary to the first evidenced unequal boundary, or from ingest if no equal boundary exists. Use a next check limited to available neighboring input/output records or manifest/field consistency. Apply the stipulated transform-record removals during final review and revise affected uncertainty. Within the additional twenty minutes, compare the ledger and timestamp variant on the two disjoint three-pair subsets; freeze outputs before opening the two sealed answers. Check localization, unresolved intervals, citations and counts; different subsets limit comparative conclusions.
assumptions: Expected stage order organizes comparisons but does not prove execution or explain a mismatch.
Available digests identify comparable artifact boundaries; ambiguous mappings remain unresolved.
Capacity within sixty minutes is unverified; insufficient time or inspection allowance yields an explicit unresolved result.

assessment: Ordinary digest comparison plus a traceable evidence ledger; proposed workflow and probe, with no claimed measured performance or causal diagnosis.
